text: こんな　うわさが…　キョウは　くすりにも　くわしく　ポケモンが　きずつくと　みずから　くすりを　つくって　いやすらしい！

structure.jp: キョウは　くすりにも　くわしく
structure.en: Koga also knows a lot about medicine, and

structure.jp: ポケモンが　きずつくと
みずから　くすりを　つくって　いやすらしい！
structure.en: he apparently makes medicine himself and heals them!

patterns.name: 〜らしい
patterns.explanation: らしい after a verb means 'apparently' or 'I hear that': the speaker is going by what others say. いやすらしい = 'apparently he heals them'.

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'when' or 'whenever' this happens, the next thing follows. ポケモンが　きずつくと = 'when his Pokémon get hurt'.

patterns.name: 〜く (linking)
patterns.explanation: Changing the last い of a describing word to く lets the sentence carry on, like 'and' in writing. くすりにも　くわしく = 'he also knows medicine well, and'.
